title: Turning from a backward to a forward scan
statement: Let $A$ be an alphabet, $S$ a state set, and $x$ a finite input word. For any optional state $q$, state $q'$, input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ allowed positions, integer frontier $z$, lists $l,r$ of possibly blank symbols, output word $out$, and possibly blank symbol $b$, applying the action that writes $b$, moves the work head right, leaves the input head and output unchanged, and enters state $q'$ to the backward-facing configuration at $z$ gives the forward-facing configuration at $z+1$ with left list $b$ followed by the tail of $r$, right list $l$, input-head position $p$, and output $out$.
hypotheses_covered: An alphabet $A$, state set $S$, and finite input word $x$
Lists $l,r$ of possibly blank symbols and output word $out$
replaced:
Consider a one-work-tape configuration in backward-facing zipper form: work head at cell
$z$, a list $r$ occupying cells $z, z-1, \dots$, and a list $l$ occupying cells
$z+1, z+2, \dots$. Applying the sweep action that writes a symbol $b$ at the current
cell, moves the work head right, leaves the input head and output unchanged, and enters
a state $q'$ yields the forward-facing zipper at $z+1$: cells $z, z-1, \dots$ hold $b$
followed by the tail of $r$, and cells $z+1, z+2, \dots$ hold $l$.
